label: Every ESSENCE_6 condition of an actual root's own nature is seated in a real constituent of it
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred (SEAT): for every actual concrete root r at w and every ESSENCE_6 condition C in r's own nature on r's profile, some real constituent k of r is such that C belongs to what k is (SeatedIn). No condition of a root's nature floats free of everything real in it. It does not say which constituent, that the constituent realizes any determination, or that the condition is a requirement of anything. A rival that places a bare negative clause 'lacks noesis' in a simple root's one nature accepts it; it is denied by a clause in the nature that is in no real constituent (a non-real contained item, or a nature distinct from the one real constituent).
